{"id":1849286048,"question_id":3860,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1765112746,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"107 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1849286048/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Resulting String After Adjacent Removals","memory":"61.5 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    string resultingString(string s) {\n        stack<char>st;\n        \n        for(int i =0 ; i < s.size(); i++)\n        {\n            if(!st.empty() and (abs(st.top() - s[i]) == 1 or abs(st.top() - s[i]) == 25))\n            {\n                st.pop();\n            }\n            else\n            st.push(s[i]);\n        }\n        string ans = \"\";\n        if(st.empty()) return ans;\n        else \n        {\n            while(!st.empty())\n            {\n                ans.push_back(st.top());\n                st.pop();\n            }\n            reverse(ans.begin() , ans.end());\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"resulting-string-after-adjacent-removals","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1257}
